Selected outside sources

Editorial starting points, not a ranking.

  • National Council on Problem Gambling help

    National Council on Problem Gambling · Free · Support information

    An official starting point for finding gambling-related support and treatment information.

    Before you use it: Support resources are separate from performance coaching; use the current contact options on the source page.

    Public page read · 2026-10-07 · Full listing

  • Poker TDA rules and procedures

    Poker Tournament Directors Association · Free · Official rules

    Tournament rules, recommended procedures, and examples from the association that publishes them.

    Before you use it: Directly read the official 2026 rules, version 1.0 dated September 7, 2026, including procedures and the addendum. TDA rules supplement house rules; applicable agency rules take precedence.

    Public page read · 2026-10-07 · Full listing

  • PokerStars: third-party tools and services policy

    PokerStars · Free · Official rules

    Operator policy distinguishing permitted tools, tools prohibited at all times and tools restricted while its software is open.

    Before you use it: Policy text read, not independent enforcement testing. Applies to this operator and can change. This is not an endorsement, eligibility check or permission to use a specific tool.

    Public page read · 2026-10-08 · Full listing
